## Status: In development

Study 08 is paused and no completed benchmark result is claimed. The repository
preserves two-trait state, simulation, alignment, extraction, diagnostic,
runtime, and metric prototypes for future work.

The principal implementation blocker is that the current `sblr` multivariate
block-eigen backend uses reconstructed dense operators. Retained-low-rank
multivariate execution and the associated scientific design must be resolved
before benchmark fitting resumes.

See the [development README](README.md) and the
[benchmark catalogue](../index.qmd). No Study 08 reference capsule is presented
as authoritative evidence.
